data.title: Edwards Lifesciences Thailand Marks 25 Years in Thailand WITH Access to Heart Valve Care
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand, October 12, 2026 – Edwards Lifesciences, the global leader in structural heart disease innovation, celebrated 25 years of operations in Thailand, marking a milestone in its longstanding commitment to advancing heart valve care through collaboration with healthcare professionals, hospitals, government agencies, partners and patient communities.

data.title: Central Pattana highlights robust office portfolio, celebrates successful first year of Central Park Offices
data.description: Showcases a portfolio of 11 office buildings in prime locations across Bangkok, offering over 400,000 sq.m. of leasable space and consistently maintaining an average portfolio occupancy rate of over 90%.

data.title: Radware Launches New Cloud Security Service Centre in Thailand
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand – October 8, 2026 – Radware (NASDAQ: RDWR), a global provider of AI-powered cybersecurity solutions, is expanding its presence in Thailand with the launch of a new Cloud Security Service Centre connected to the company’s global Cloud Security network.

data.title: Dusit Thani Hua Hin Unveils ‘The Art of Celebration’ Festive Season
data.description: Hua Hin, Thailand – October 2026 – Dusit Thani Hua Hin will celebrate Christmas and welcome 2027 with The Art of Celebration, a festive programme running from December 24, 2026, to January 1, 2027. Bringing together the resort’s beachfront setting and distinct dining venues, the programme spans Christmas Eve dinners, Christmas Day brunch and Italian dining, followed by two New Year’s Eve celebrations, fireworks and a relaxed start to the new year.

data.title: Planning a Japan or China Trip? M Card Unlocks Exclusive Shopping and Lifestyle Privileges
data.description: From tax-free shopping and additional discounts in Japan to VIP lounges, dining benefits and exclusive experiences across Greater China, M Card connects members with privileges beyond Thailand.

data.title: Tanit Chearavanont at Forbes Global CEO Conference 2026: Why Makro had to build its own technology
data.description: At the Forbes Global CEO Conference 2026 in Singapore, Tanit Chearavanont, Group CEO Wholesale Business at CP AXTRA, shared how Makro transformed from a traditional cash-and-carry wholesaler into a retail technology business and why the journey demanded bold decisions, perseverance and the conviction to challenge the status quo.

data.title: LG levels up the gaming industry with new monitors
data.description: BANGKOK, Oct 8, 2026 – LG Electronics (Thailand) Co, Ltd, reinforcing its position as a global leader in monitor innovation, has officially announced the launch and availability of two new flagship models in the LG UltraGear™ lineup. Packed with world-class technologies engineered to deliver unparalleled gaming and user experience, the new monitors feature ultra-fast speeds tailored for competitive esports, alongside AI-powered visuals and immersive audio on expansive OLED displays. Gamers can now experience and own these latest monitors starting today.

data.title: Huawei Thailand wins two HR Asia awards
data.description: Bangkok, 7 October 2026 – Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. has been recognized at the HR Asia Awards 2026 , receiving two prestigious awards, HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026 and HR Asia Tech Empowerment Awards 2026 , and marking the fourth consecutive year that Huawei Thailand has received recognition from the HR Asia Awards.

data.title: SYMPHONY elevates to the global stage, led by its Global Business Group
data.description: SYMPHONY COMMUNICATION PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED, or SYMPHONY, reinforces its strategic direction toward global expansion, led by its SYMPHONY Global Business Group (GBG) executive team, which plays a key role in driving international connectivity and elevating Thai enterprises to the global network.

data.title: B. Braun Thailand named Best Company to Work for in Asia for seventh year
data.description: B. Braun (Thailand) Ltd, one of the world's leading medical technology companies, has been recognised as HR Asia's "Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026" for the seventh consecutive year. Demonstrating its continued focus on workplace culture, the company also received two special honours: the "HR Asia Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Award" for the fourth consecutive year, and the "HR Asia Sustainable Workplace Award" for the second consecutive year.

data.title: Novo launches holistic care treatment for adults living with type 2 diabetes
data.description: Novo launches a higher dose Semaglutide treatment option in Thailand for adults with type 2 diabetes.

data.title: First Highgate International School opens in Chon Buri, Thailand
data.description: CHON BURI, Oct 7, 2026 - Highgate International School Thailand, established through a collaboration between Siam Motors Group and Highgate School UK , officially opened its first campus outside the United Kingdom at a ceremony presided over by Palakorn Suwanrath, Privy Councillor, President of the Rajaprajanugroh Foundation under Royal Patronage and Executive Committee Member of the Chaipattana Foundation. The ceremony was attended by the school’s management team, teachers, parents and distinguished guests. The ceremony marked the opening of the first overseas campus of Highgate School, the prestigious British educational institution with a history spanning more than 460 years.

data.title: Optiwise & Friends Highlights the Rise of Strategic IR
data.description: BANGKOK, Oct 1, 2026 — Optiwise Co Ltd, a disclosure service provider and investor relations (IR) partner to listed companies, hosted “Optiwise & Friends: Redefining IR Amid Market Volatility — Trust. ESG. AI. What’s Next for IR?” at Gaysorn Tower in Bangkok, bringing together senior executives and IR professionals from leading Thai companies to exchange perspectives on the evolving role of investor relations amid market volatility, changing investor expectations and new challenges facing the capital market.

data.title: Marriott Signs Landmark Deal with FICO for 7 New Thailand Hotels
data.description: Agreement to add 1,262 rooms and expand luxury and lifestyle portfolios, including JW Marriott Bangkok Sathorn and the anticipated debut of citizenM, Four Points Flex by Sheraton and Series by Marriott in Thailand

data.title: DBS students secure fifth consecutive Tournament of Champions qualification at Yale
data.description: Students from DBS Denla British School have secured their fifth consecutive qualification for the Tournament of Champions (TOC) at Yale University in the United States, following an outstanding performance at the World Scholar’s Cup (WSC) Bangkok Global Round 2026. DBS students achieved an impressive 10 Trophies, 46 Gold medals and 27 Silver medals across the competition, earning the opportunity to represent the school at the Tournament of Champions.

data.title: PROUD wins four major awards, reinforcing its ‘Luxury Wellness Developer’ brand
data.description: At a time when the definition of “Luxury Living” is no longer limited to location, materials or a project’s image, but is shifting towards the long-term design of a better life, “Wellness” is becoming one of the key standards of modern living. It is also a direction that Proud Real Estate Public Company Limited, or PROUD, has consistently placed at the core of its brand.

data.title: Insignia brings ‘A Taste of Insignia’ to Thailand, marking market entry with Siam Piwat
data.description: BANGKOK, THAILAND , 5 October 2026 — Insignia, a global leader in bespoke lifestyle management and ultra-premium payment solutions, today marks its entry into Thailand with A Taste of Insignia, an exclusive experience in Bangkok presented as part of Unlock the World of Insignia. Created as an intimate introduction to the world of Insignia. The experience brings together the brand’s bespoke lifestyle management services, ultra-premium financial solutions, and carefully curated global network, introducing its philosophy of personalised access and possibility to Thailand for the first time.

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor PLC Earns Recognition for Financial Education at ESGBusiness Awards 2026
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , won the Social Inclusion and Equal Opportunities Award - Thailand at the ESGBusiness Awards 2026 . The award recognizes the organization's outstanding performance in driving equality and fostering social inclusion through the "Financial Knowledge to Communities for Life Rolls Forward" project, which has been operating continuously for over a decade. This reflects the company's intention to elevate people's quality of life through creating financial knowledge opportunities, aiming to promote sustainably better lives for people in society.

data.title: Bangkok Central Kitchen brings healthy meals to 1500 students
data.description: "Bangkok, City for Better Health" launched a "Central Kitchen" at Wat Don School, enabling the preparation of nutritious meals for almost 1,500 students across seven schools in the Sathon and Bang Rak districts.

data.title: Salad Factory Partners with USDA to Launch "Taste of USA" Campaign
data.description: Salad Factory is partnering with the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the U.S. Embassy in Thailand to launch the "Taste of USA" campaign. The campaign was officially launched by Mr. Piya Dankum , Chief Executive Officer of Green Food Factory Co., Ltd., and Mr. Victorino “Mayo” Floro IV , Regional Agricultural Attaché, USDA/U.S. Embassy Bangkok. It invites Thai consumers to discover the quality and flavors of ingredients from across the United States, including Alaska, through seven dishes developed by the Salad Factory culinary team. Each dish highlights the qualities of its featured ingredient while reflecting the brand's signature style.

data.title: Aura Bangkok Clinic takes T-Beauty global with the world’s 1st airport-based aesthetic clinic
data.description: BANGKOK —Sept 15, 2026 — Aura Wellness Public Co Ltd, the holding company behind Aura Bangkok Clinic, Aura Xpress Clinic and AURASOL, today confirmed that its flagship brand, Aura Bangkok Clinic, has opened the world's first aesthetic clinic to operate beyond immigration inside an international airport departure hall, in the Departure Hall at Suvarnabhumi airport’s Concourse G. For Aura Wellness, the opening marks a milestone in its broader strategy to establish Thailand as the world’s leading beauty and wellness destination, rather than simply one of several options for travellers.

data.title: MiVana Launches Organic Coffee Cherry 'Shot Drink' to Tap Into Wellness Market
data.description: MiVana Company Limited, part of the Premier Group, has launched MiVana SHOT DRINK, a ready-to-drink wellness beverage made from organic coffee cherry pulp sourced from watershed forests in the northern province of Chiang Rai. The launch expands the company’s business beyond organic coffee into the wellness market, with a sales target of 100 million baht in the first 12 months .
